name: The American Club
summary: Full-facility membership club in Claymore with dining, sport, and a large US-linked community.
body: The American Club is a default comparison point for family memberships: pool, fitness, F&B, and kids’ programming in a central location. Waitlists and entrance fees are real — treat joining as a housing-adjacent decision, not an impulse add-on.
membershipNotes: Entrance fees + monthly dues; ask about current waitlist by category.
